correctness.rationale: PASS: Encode x as fair binary digits; avoiding hole 00 or 11 at step j forbids the pair s_js_j. Exact survivor count is C_n=(1,1)∏M_{s_j}(1,1)^T with M0=((0,1),(1,1)), M1=((1,1),(1,0)). Updating a positive integer row increases total by at least 1 and by exactly 1 at every alternating step, giving n+2 and equality. The larger entry after each step equals previous total, so C_{n+1}<=C_n+C_{n-1} with (2,3) initial values and equality precisely upon repeating symbols, yielding F_{n+3}. Tail sums produce exact 3<=E[L]<=5 with unique alternating/constant infinite schedules. For periodic s, Perron growth of Q_s gives entropy log rho(Q_s)/r and escape log2-entropy; uniform cylinders yield dimension entropy/log2. Alternating period product is unipotent with rho=1 and countable survivors. Mixed-symbol norm is strictly <phi^r by ||M0M1||2=1+sqrt2<phi²; any period with repeated adjacent symbols has rho>1 because other length-two blocks dominate identity. Thus all strict periodic cases are covered. Independent brute binary-prefix checks passed 1023 schedule cases; infinite claims rest on matrix inequalities.
residual_risks: Graph-directed dimension invokes standard mass distribution/Perron reasoning; this holds for fixed periodic schedules and not arbitrary aperiodic ones.
